projects.title: 一剑破界
projects.subtitle: 角色设计、动作镜头与生图工作流

hero.caption: ImageGen 站姿修订全景：双脚落在同一祭坛上

projects.intro: 以银发、短须、黑袍与紫瞳建立角色识别，通过回身横斩、剑锋近镜和侧身突进探索动作镜头。再以站姿复核、原生尺寸图生图与放大对照，记录从视觉方向到本地处理的完整过程。
facts: 动作机位 / 剑线 / 支撑关系
角色视觉 / 镜头变体 / 实验记录

sections.title: 一个角色，三种动作阅读
sections.text: 角色母图用黑袍建立大暗面，以金色剑气组织方向，再用紫色轮廓光分开人物与夜空。新动作镜头由 ImageGen 生成：横斩关注躯干转向与挥剑方向；近镜检查剑柄、手腕与剑身轴线；突进用肩、肘和衣袖形成速度层次。

images.caption: 角色母图 · ImageGen
动作 B · 剑锋近镜；近景裁切不作为全身站姿验证
动作 A · 回身横斩
动作 C · 侧身突进

sections.title: 先确认落点，再检查遮挡
sections.text: 站姿修订从髋、膝、踝的关系看向双脚：脚尖微向外，膝踝顺着脚向，两处鞋底落在同一祭坛上。体块参考与修订全景均为 ImageGen 图像，用于复核支撑和遮挡关系；本项目没有创建角色网格或骨骼绑定。

images.caption: ImageGen 体块研究 · 支撑与双手握剑关系
修订后的站姿全景 · 双脚接触关系

sections.title: 低重绘，仍要检查角色是否漂移
sections.text: 本地 ComfyUI 从 1086 × 1448 母图出发，右侧补齐 2 像素后编码、采样、解码，再裁回原尺寸。实验固定 seed 314159、20 步、CFG 4、denoise 0.08。眼神和笑意仍有漂移，因此保留过程记录，结果没有替换母图。

images.caption: 实际 ComfyUI 原生尺寸图生图画布与对应输出；实验结果未采用

sections.title: 放大两倍，比较边缘与新生纹理
sections.text: Real-ESRGAN 4× 推理后缩至 2×，与 Lanczos 2× 基线并行比较；两路均实际运行并保存为 2172 × 2896。复核眼线、发丝和衣袍边缘，区分可读性提升与新生纹理，不把新增细节当作原图细节的恢复。

images.caption: 实际双分支放大流程 · RealESRGAN_x4plus 与 Lanczos 基线

sections.title: 换场景，也持续复核同一角色
sections.text: 背景方向从碎形、浮门与密集电光转向雾海留白，让黑袍暗面和剑气重新成为视线中心。祭坛全景与雨庭回望是独立的 ImageGen 镜头，保留紫瞳、短须等识别点，但衣袍配件仍有差异，不能视为完全一致的角色资产。

images.caption: 雨庭回望 · 独立生成的同角色镜头

sections.title: 让一次运行留下可复核的记录
sections.text: 本地执行通过 Hermes ComfyUI Skill 绑定输入、注入参数并提交工作流；监控运行后核对输出文件、尺寸与哈希，再检查脸、手、轮廓和纹理。视觉方向由 ImageGen 完成，本地流程记录实际运行与输出，各自保留清楚的边界。

images.caption: 双角色收束画面 · ImageGen 合成视觉

projects.title: 噪点爆发
projects.subtitle: 色彩语言、结构控制与海报延展

hero.caption: 原创街头角色母图 · ImageGen

projects.intro: 围绕黑白外套与前伸手势建立角色主形，用青色冲击、品红背景和黄色方向线构成高对比的视觉语言。将角色延伸为结构控制实验、三种海报版式和静态 FX 形状概念。
facts: 青 / 品红 / 黄与黑白主形
海报版式 / 静态 FX 概念

sections.title: 先看边缘，再决定约束什么
sections.text: Canny 边缘预览为 768 × 432，low 0.15、high 0.35。衣领、手势与头发轮廓可辨，但纸感纹理和背景也产生大量细边，整图约束会一并携带这些噪声。后续实验在 512 × 288 输入上以相同阈值重新计算边缘。

images.caption: 实际 Canny 边缘预览 · 768 × 432
实际 ComfyUI Canny 预处理画布

sections.title: 控制住手势轮廓，仍需单独审脸和手指
sections.text: 固定输入、seed、prompt 与 denoise 0.36，仅比较 ControlNet strength 0 和 0.65；使用 20 步、CFG 6、seed 314159。0.65 的手势和白外套更接近原图，但脸、手指和笔触仍然变化。两次输出均未采用，最终保留原母图。

images.caption: 实际对照记录 · strength 0 与 0.65，输出为 512 × 288；两版均未采用

sections.title: 同一母图，三种阅读距离
sections.text: 海报不重新生成角色，而是把图像和文字分层，通过裁切、字级和黑色留白改变阅读顺序：近距离的角色识别、文字与图像的张力，以及手势局部的冲击感。以下为实际排版应用。

images.caption: 三种海报版式 · 同一 ImageGen 母图的排版延展

sections.title: 把色彩转成四种静态 FX 形状
sections.text: 爆发聚紧核心，上挑强调弧线，弹道保留尖锐前端，环形让中心留暗。青、品红与黄围绕明亮核心组织方向，作为后续动效的形状参考；此阶段为静态概念，没有制作逐帧动画、时序或引擎参数。

images.caption: 静态 FX 概念板 · 爆发 / 上挑 / 弹道 / 环形扩散

sections.title: 两种视觉语言，在同一画面相遇
sections.text: 金色剑气与青色掌波在裂隙中交汇，把两个角色的轮廓、色彩和动作方向放在同一张收束画面中。该画面由 ImageGen 生成，作为作品集的双角色视觉延展。

images.caption: 一剑破界 × 噪点爆发 · 双角色收束画面

projects.title: 药盒饮水器
projects.subtitle: 适老用药提醒与饮水一体化设计

hero.caption: 药盒饮水器 · 产品概念渲染

projects.intro: 围绕老年人在居家服药中容易遗忘、找药和分药步骤繁琐的问题，将储药、定量分药、定时提醒与即热饮水组织为一套产品概念，并通过设备屏幕和手机端连接家属的协同查看与设置。
facts: 用户研究 / 产品方案 / 双端 UI
老年人的居家服药与饮水
储药、提醒、定量分药与家属协同

sections.title: 从收纳药物，转向理解服药行为
sections.text: 调研比较了传统分药盒与智能药盒。传统产品主要解决分类与携带，倒药、数药和取药的过程仍需要额外操作；智能产品增加提醒与记录功能。设计由此把重点放在服药前后的完整流程，而不仅是药物收纳。

images.caption: 传统分药盒与智能药盒的调研总结

sections.title: 把访谈与观察，转化为清晰的需求
sections.text: 访谈围绕日常服药习惯、遗忘和中断、产品使用偏好及家属参与展开。行为观察将过程拆为取药、分药、准备饮水和服药：精确倒出所需数量、暂存不同药物，以及往返取水，都可能增加操作负担。方案优先回应定时提醒、储药与定量分药、家属远程协助。

images.caption: 从用户需求到产品功能的对应关系

sections.title: 用教具模拟，发现操作中的负担
sections.text: 模拟任务包括上下楼、更换饮用水、分药、接热水、倒药与语音沟通。PPT 的单次体验记录中，分药用时 4 分 9 秒，接热水用时 1 分 24 秒，并记录了近似色难辨、手腕负担和水位不易判断等问题。这些教具模拟观察用于指导配色、产品高度、材料和反馈设计。

images.caption: 老年教具模拟中的任务用时与体验反馈

sections.title: 把提醒、取药与饮水连在一起
sections.text: 故事板将预设提醒、准备温水、听到提示、取杯、选择对应药品、取药、饮水和完成反馈串联起来。储药与出药结构、定时提醒及家属协同共同构成方案；电子药房处方导入作为后续功能设想列入概念研究。

images.caption: 从提醒、取药到饮水的使用故事板

sections.title: 把储药与饮水放进同一件日常产品
sections.text: 造型围绕储药区域、取水区与杯座组织，采用暖白与橙色建立温暖、易识别的视觉关系。体量研究包含约 2 L 水箱与 400 mL 杯子的容量设定；药品包装、尺寸与储存要求也作为结构推演的约束。

images.caption: 水箱与杯子容量的方案推演

sections.title: 设备端，让操作与完成状态清楚可见
sections.text: 饮水主页面集中显示水温、温度调节、水量选择和接水入口，顶部保留清洁与锁定功能。服药页面通过到时提示、药品选择、图标点亮和完成文案，区分待处理与已完成的操作状态。

images.caption: 饮水机屏幕的主要操作状态
方案中的到时提醒、选择药品与完成反馈

sections.title: 手机端，让家属参与查看和设置
sections.text: 首页通过日期、服药时间和药品种类概览组织信息，再展示具体药品与剂量。方案设计了完成状态查看、新增服药信息，以及提醒时间和药量的设置入口，让设备端与手机端围绕同一条服药流程展开。

images.caption: 手机端信息查看、完成状态与新增服药信息

sections.title: 让概念进入真实的家居尺度
sections.text: 通过不同光线和摆放方式的产品渲染，检查储药区、取水区域与杯座的视觉关系，并呈现产品在居家环境中的整体感受。

about.summary: 工业设计背景，现于燕山大学研究生阶段学习。围绕工业装备、数字孪生与交互体验开展实践，参与从现场调研、三维资产到界面原型和编辑器功能的设计工作。工作之外，喜欢语言交流、健身、动画、剪辑与游戏。
education: 研究生阶段学习 / 工业设计 / GPA 3.80
experience: 爱室丽家居 · 数字孪生项目
担任资产美术负责人，参与项目从 0 到 1 的建设。设计内部工厂数字孪生 3D 编辑器，涉及资产收集、优化与维护、原型、物流仿真、AGV 逻辑与数据中台。
华电曹妃甸重工装备 · 数字孪生项目

河北永明地质工程机械 · 钻井车设计
负责 ID、VI 与动画。根据中石化要求设计钻井车外观及 4 分钟动画，多次到工地调研人机尺寸与易用性，输出十余款外观设计和多款涂装方案，部分方案已落地。
天津工程机械研究院 · 数字孪生项目
担任模型渲染、动画负责人，完成重机厂不同跨区的建模渲染、零件点云生成动画及干涉碰撞数据，项目已落地。
基于调温材料的智能帐篷
上海市创新创业市级项目组长，负责材料制作、外形与交互设计。充气材料经东华大学国家级实验室测试具有明显保温作用，相关实用新型专利已受理。
awards: 第 34 届金犊奖公共艺术创作优秀奖

参与床垫、沙发与板材产线的自动化和数字化改造，整理工厂及供应商设备模型。赴越南工厂实地调研，建设模型与材质资产库，编写内部 3D 编辑器功能，并参与机械狗和灵巧手测试。

构建绿氨制备及掺烧全流程的三维可视化模型，呈现设备外观、内部结构和工艺流程，并参与基于物理模型与数学算法的模拟引擎开发。
上海圆贝信息科技 · 产品经理
负责 iOS、Android、HarmonyOS 三端套餐页面的交互设计，推动 PC 支付模块完善，提出支付界面优化方案；完成海外版生意专家 App 测试，并负责企业宣传手册策划。

en.涂装造型与品牌视觉: Industrial styling, colour and brand identity
en.面向大型工程装备的真实制造场景，梳理井架、平台与车身的造型关系，并以统一的涂装和: A production project for heavy engineering equipment. I coordinated the visual relationship between the mast, platforms and vehicle body, then brought the equipment together through a consistent colour scheme and visual identity.
en.河北永明地质工程机械 / 中国石化: Hebei Yongming Geological Engineering Machinery / Sinopec
en.从整机布局到局部构件: From the full vehicle to individual components
en.项目围绕井架配色、护板随车造型、平台护栏、套管系统与车载设备展开。通过多轮方案推: The project covered mast colours, body panels, platform railings, the casing system and onboard equipment. Iterative concepts aligned the exterior with the equipment structure and operating areas.
en.在阶段性方案中进一步整合车身色块、护板与设备比例。后续将企业视觉语言应用到整机，: Later iterations refined the relationship between body colour blocks, protective panels and equipment proportions. Applying the company’s visual language across the vehicle connected product styling with brand recognition.
en.把产品语言延伸到品牌: Extending the product language into a brand
en.从标志与配色推演到企业视觉识别手册，将装备的视觉形象延伸到规范化的品牌应用。: Logo and colour studies developed into a visual identity manual, translating the equipment’s appearance into consistent brand applications.
en.车载套管钻机整体造型与设备布局: Drilling rig: overall styling and equipment layout
en.车载设备布局及涂装设计: Onboard equipment layout and colour scheme
en.车身两侧护板与整车涂装成果: Body panels and vehicle colour application
en.后续阶段的整机造型与视觉涂装: Later iteration: integrated styling and graphics
en.第二轮配色与品牌应用: Second round of colours and brand applications
en.车间场景、点云与可视化: Workshop environments, point clouds and visualisation
en.把复杂的重机厂车间转化为可观察的数字场景，结合 AGV 扫描、零件点云与动画可视: A digital representation of a complex heavy-machinery workshop. AGV scanning, component point clouds and animated visualisation make production information easier to understand.
en.天津工程机械研究院: Tianjin Research Institute of Construction Machinery
en.项目负责人 / ID、动画、渲染: Project lead / industrial design, animation and rendering
en.通过 Blender 建模与 Unity 场景交互搭建，还原车间绿色通道、移运小: Blender modelling and interactive Unity scenes recreated circulation routes, transfer vehicles, gantries and storage areas, clarifying the spatial relationship between equipment and logistics.
en.从实物零件到点云模型: From physical components to point clouds
en.围绕 AGV 扫描车间搭建场景与动画，表现零件扫描、点云生成和虚拟装配的过程。点: Scenes and animations explain AGV scanning, point-cloud generation and virtual assembly. Denoising and registration prepare the point clouds for assembly visualisation and interference checks.
en.数字场景走向现场展示: Bringing the digital scene on site
en.在可视化系统中整合设备状态、工单进度与环境监测等信息，让复杂车间的运行情况更便于: Equipment status, work-order progress and environmental monitoring were integrated into the visualisation system. The proposal was implemented for on-site presentation in the central control room.
en.重机厂整体布局的数字场景: Digital overview of the heavy-machinery factory
en.绿色通道、物流设备与作业区域: Circulation routes, logistics equipment and work areas
en.点云虚拟装配与干涉检查: Virtual assembly and interference checks using point clouds
en.生产线数字化与三维编辑工具: Production-line digitalisation and a 3D editing tool
en.面向 Ashley 家具床垫厂的产线数字化改造，参与 UE 编辑器开发，负责模型: For Ashley’s mattress-factory digitalisation project, I contributed to the UE editor and led model and UI work. Equipment assets, 3D environments and editing operations come together in a tool for scene editing, navigation and simulation.
en.围绕编辑模式、漫游模式与仿真模式设计 UI，将场景编辑、空间浏览和仿真操作分别组: The UI separates editing, navigation and simulation into clear workspaces, with panels and controls organised around the tasks in each mode.
en.针对床垫生产线设备进行资产内存优化，为复杂产线中的模型组合与实时展示降低资源负担: Equipment assets were optimised to reduce memory requirements in complex production-line scenes. The supplied project documentation reports an equipment-asset memory reduction of more than 99%.
en.从单个模型到可复用的资产库: From individual models to a reusable library
en.基于 UE C++ 参与功能开发，将资产库与通用资产组织进编辑器，支持设备模型在: UE C++ development helped organise the asset library and shared assets for reuse across production-line scenes. The viewport, asset panel and properties area form the editing workspace.
en.床垫产线数字化场景与 UE 编辑器界面: Mattress production line and UE editor interface
en.编辑模式、漫游模式与仿真模式的界面设计: UI for editing, navigation and simulation modes
en.床垫生产线设备资产与模型优化: Production equipment assets and model optimisation
en.适老共享助洁车: An assisted-care mobility and hygiene system
en.关注介助型老年人的如厕与清洁需求，以人因研究协调床体、移位器与助洁车之间的动作，: A concept addressing toileting and hygiene for older adults who need assistance. Human-factors research coordinated movement between the bed, transfer device and hygiene unit to make the care sequence more continuous.
en.以智能、护理、移动与清洁四个关键点构建设计体系。把智能床推起、一键召唤、移位器承: The design framework focuses on intelligence, care, movement and hygiene. Bed elevation, one-touch calling, transfer support and rotation were studied as parts of the same sequence.
en.通过草图与三维模型探索整体构型，并在展开、承接和移位状态之间调整设备的空间关系。: Sketches and 3D studies explored the overall configuration, refining spatial relationships as the device opens, supports the user and transfers them.
en.照顾身体接触的细节: Designing for contact with the body
en.接触部件考虑温暖的硅胶触感、可拆卸换洗结构与一次性马桶垫。设计同时梳理设备运行的: Contact components explore a warm silicone feel, removable washable parts and disposable toilet-seat liners. The proposal also considers operating-light feedback and key human dimensions.
en.设备展开状态: The device in its open configuration
en.面向渤海湾海洋生态恢复与资源利用的装备设计研究，围绕近海海域的种子投放，探索母机: An equipment-design study for ecological restoration and resource use in Bohai Bay. The concept explores a carrier and smaller planting units working together to distribute seeds in coastal waters.
en.子机，负责近海投种: A compact unit for coastal planting
en.以细长机身整合种子储存与投放结构，围绕近海海域使用场景推敲子机的外形、推进部件与: A slender body integrates seed storage and distribution. Form, propulsion and connection details were developed around use in coastal waters.
en.母机，组织整个作业系统: A carrier that organises the system
en.母机携带种子仓与 6 个子机仓。通过系统组合展示母机、子机及连接关系，让单机设计: The carrier accommodates a seed compartment and six planting-unit bays. System studies show how the carrier, smaller units and connections work together in an operating scenario.
en.角色设计、动作镜头与生图工作流: Character design, action shots and image-generation workflows
en.以银发、短须、黑袍与紫瞳建立角色识别，通过回身横斩、剑锋近镜和侧身突进探索动作镜: Silver hair, a short beard, a black robe and violet eyes establish the character. Turning slashes, blade close-ups and side-on lunges explore action framing. Stance reviews, native-resolution image-to-image tests and upscaling comparisons document the path from visual direction to local processing.
en.动作机位 / 剑线 / 支撑关系: Camera angles / sword direction / physical support
en.角色视觉 / 镜头变体 / 实验记录: Character visuals / shot variants / experiment records
en.一个角色，三种动作阅读: One character, three ways to read movement
en.角色母图用黑袍建立大暗面，以金色剑气组织方向，再用紫色轮廓光分开人物与夜空。新动: The master image uses the black robe as a large dark shape, gold sword energy to establish direction and violet rim light to separate the figure from the night sky. ImageGen produced the action shots: the slash explores torso rotation and sword direction; the close-up checks the alignment of hilt, wrist and blade; the lunge layers shoulders, elbows and sleeves to suggest speed.
en.站姿修订从髋、膝、踝的关系看向双脚：脚尖微向外，膝踝顺着脚向，两处鞋底落在同一祭: The stance review follows the hips, knees and ankles down to the feet: toes angle slightly outward, knees and ankles follow the feet, and both soles contact the same altar. The volume study and revised wide shot are ImageGen images for reviewing support and overlap. No character mesh or skeletal rig was created.
en.低重绘，仍要检查角色是否漂移: Even low denoise can change the character
en.本地 ComfyUI 从 1086 × 1448 母图出发，右侧补齐 2 像素后: The local ComfyUI test starts with the 1086 × 1448 master, pads two pixels on the right for encoding, sampling and decoding, then crops back to the original size. Settings: seed 314159, 20 steps, CFG 4 and denoise 0.08. The gaze and expression still changed, so the result was documented rather than replacing the master.
en.放大两倍，比较边缘与新生纹理: Upscaling twice, comparing edges and new texture
en.Real-ESRGAN 4× 推理后缩至 2×，与 Lanczos 2× 基线并: Real-ESRGAN 4× inference was reduced to 2× and compared with a Lanczos 2× baseline. Both branches were run and saved at 2172 × 2896. Eye lines, hair and robe edges were reviewed to distinguish improved readability from newly generated texture.
en.换场景，也持续复核同一角色: Keeping the character readable across settings
en.背景方向从碎形、浮门与密集电光转向雾海留白，让黑袍暗面和剑气重新成为视线中心。祭: The setting moved from fragments, floating gates and dense lightning to open mist, refocusing attention on the black robe and sword energy. The altar wide shot and rainy-courtyard view are independently generated ImageGen shots. Violet eyes and the short beard remain, but robe details differ; these are not fully consistent production character assets.
en.让一次运行留下可复核的记录: Leaving a traceable record of each run
en.本地执行通过 Hermes ComfyUI Skill 绑定输入、注入参数并提交: Local runs used the Hermes ComfyUI Skill to bind inputs, inject parameters and submit workflows. Outputs, dimensions and hashes were checked before reviewing faces, hands, silhouettes and textures. ImageGen supplied the visual direction; local workflow records document the actual processing and outputs.
en.ImageGen 站姿修订全景：双脚落在同一祭坛上: Revised ImageGen stance: both feet contact the same altar
en.动作 B · 剑锋近镜；近景裁切不作为全身站姿验证: Action B: blade close-up; this crop does not validate a full-body stance
en.ImageGen 体块研究 · 支撑与双手握剑关系: ImageGen volume study: support and a two-handed sword grip
en.实际 ComfyUI 原生尺寸图生图画布与对应输出；实验结果未采用: Actual native-resolution ComfyUI workflow and output; result not adopted
en.实际双分支放大流程 · RealESRGAN_x4plus 与 Lanczos: Actual two-branch upscale workflow: RealESRGAN_x4plus and Lanczos
en.雨庭回望 · 独立生成的同角色镜头: Rainy courtyard: an independently generated character shot
en.色彩语言、结构控制与海报延展: Colour language, structural control and poster applications
en.围绕黑白外套与前伸手势建立角色主形，用青色冲击、品红背景和黄色方向线构成高对比的: A black-and-white jacket and an outstretched hand define the character. Cyan impact shapes, a magenta background and yellow directional lines create a high-contrast visual language, developed through structural-control experiments, three poster layouts and static FX shape studies.
en.青 / 品红 / 黄与黑白主形: Cyan / magenta / yellow with black-and-white forms
en.先看边缘，再决定约束什么: Read the edges before choosing the constraint
en.Canny 边缘预览为 768 × 432，low 0.15、high 0.35: The Canny preview is 768 × 432, with low 0.15 and high 0.35. The collar, gesture and hair silhouette remain readable, but paper texture and background also create fine edges. Whole-image control would include this noise. Later tests recalculated edges on a 512 × 288 input using the same thresholds.
en.控制住手势轮廓，仍需单独审脸和手指: Control the gesture, then review faces and fingers
en.固定输入、seed、prompt 与 denoise 0.36，仅比较 Cont: Input, seed, prompt and denoise 0.36 were held constant while comparing ControlNet strengths 0 and 0.65. Both used 20 steps, CFG 6 and seed 314159. Strength 0.65 stayed closer to the gesture and white jacket, but faces, fingers and brushwork still changed. Neither output was adopted; the original master was retained.
en.同一母图，三种阅读距离: One master image, three reading distances
en.海报不重新生成角色，而是把图像和文字分层，通过裁切、字级和黑色留白改变阅读顺序：: The posters reuse the character rather than generating it again. Image and text are layered, with crop, type scale and black negative space changing the reading order: character recognition, tension between type and image, and the impact of the hand detail.
en.把色彩转成四种静态 FX 形状: Turning colour into four static FX shapes
en.爆发聚紧核心，上挑强调弧线，弹道保留尖锐前端，环形让中心留暗。青、品红与黄围绕明: The burst concentrates the core; the rising strike emphasises an arc; the projectile keeps a pointed front; the ring leaves its centre dark. Cyan, magenta and yellow organise direction around a bright core. These are static concepts for future motion work, without frame animation, timing or engine parameters.
en.两种视觉语言，在同一画面相遇: Two visual languages in one frame
en.金色剑气与青色掌波在裂隙中交汇，把两个角色的轮廓、色彩和动作方向放在同一张收束画: Golden sword energy and a cyan palm wave meet across a rift. The composition brings both characters’ silhouettes, colours and movement directions together. ImageGen produced this closing visual as an extension of the two character studies.
en.实际对照记录 · strength 0 与 0.65，输出为 512 × 288: Actual strength 0 / 0.65 comparison at 512 × 288; neither result adopted
en.三种海报版式 · 同一 ImageGen 母图的排版延展: Three poster layouts based on one ImageGen master
en.静态 FX 概念板 · 爆发 / 上挑 / 弹道 / 环形扩散: Static FX studies: burst / rising strike / projectile / expanding ring
en.一剑破界 × 噪点爆发 · 双角色收束画面: Beyond the Blade × Chromatic Rift: closing visual
en.从熟悉的旺仔小馒头形态与童年记忆出发，把柔软、温暖的感受转化为面向大人与儿童的公: Inspired by the familiar form of Want Want’s small milk biscuits and the warmth of childhood memories, this concept turns softness and comfort into a public resting space for adults and children.
en.金犊奖旺旺双年展优秀奖: Excellence Award, Young Designers’ Want Want Biennale
en.把熟悉的形态变成空间: Turning a familiar shape into a place
en.母椅以圆润的外形构成围合休息空间，子椅回应儿童的尺度。通过草图与场景推演，将品牌: The rounded larger seat encloses a resting space, while the smaller seat responds to a child’s scale. Sketches and setting studies translate a brand memory into somewhere to sit and stay.
en.柔软感背后的材料层次: The material layers behind a soft form
en.材料方案区分表面触感层、主体填充层与内部支撑。以短绒触感、慢回弹填充和高回弹海绵: The proposal separates the tactile surface, main filling and internal support. A short-pile surface, slow-recovery filling and high-resilience foam explore comfort alongside wear, cleaning and seating safety.
en.围合式公共休息空间: An enclosed resting space for adults and children
en.子母椅的草图与形态推演: Parent-and-child seating: sketches and form studies
en.面向儿童尺度的子椅: The smaller seat at a child’s scale
en.电子相框与手机 App 的联动体验: Connecting a digital photo frame and a mobile app
en.“拍一下，就能联结。”把家庭照片的记录、分享与回看放在同一套体验中，连接电子相框: A tap brings people closer. Capturing, sharing and revisiting family photographs become one experience across a digital frame and a mobile app, connecting family members who are apart.
en.品牌视觉 / 双端 UI: Brand identity / UI for both devices

en.TapLink 由 Tap 与 Link 组成。标志融合相框与相机的视觉语言，柔: TapLink combines “Tap” and “Link”. Its mark brings together a frame and a camera, while soft apricot yellow expresses everyday companionship. Brand and interface share the same warm visual tone.
en.相框端，让照片进入日常: The frame: bringing photographs into everyday life
en.相框端以照片展示为中心，将回看、互动和相册组织放在清晰的界面中，让家人的日常可以: Photo display anchors the frame interface. Browsing, interaction and album organisation are arranged clearly so that a family’s everyday moments can be seen naturally.
en.手机端，让联结随手发生: The app: making connection easy to reach
en.App 首页以四方格呈现家人，既像相框，也像一扇窗。内容页兼顾照片收藏与 DIY: A four-part family grid works as both a frame and a window. Content pages combine saved photographs and DIY albums. The app supports uploads, frame-history browsing and remote management.
en.手机承担上传、编辑和安排照片显示的入口，相框承担展示与日常陪伴。定时发送、分辨率: The phone handles uploading, editing and scheduling; the frame handles display and everyday companionship. Scheduled sending, resolution adaptation, DIY albums and memories follow the same content flow.

en.适老用药提醒与饮水一体化设计: An assisted-living concept for medication reminders and drinking water
en.围绕老年人在居家服药中容易遗忘、找药和分药步骤繁琐的问题，将储药、定量分药、定时: A product concept addressing forgotten medication and the effort of finding and sorting tablets at home. Storage, portion dispensing, reminders and instant hot water are coordinated with an on-device interface and a companion app for family support.
en.用户研究 / 产品方案 / 双端 UI: User research / product concept / device and mobile UI
en.老年人的居家服药与饮水: Medication and drinking water for older adults at home
en.储药、提醒、定量分药与家属协同: Storage, reminders, portion dispensing and family support
en.从收纳药物，转向理解服药行为: From storing tablets to understanding the routine
en.调研比较了传统分药盒与智能药盒。传统产品主要解决分类与携带，倒药、数药和取药的过: Research compared traditional organisers with smart pillboxes. Traditional products focus on classification and portability, leaving pouring, counting and retrieval as separate tasks. Smart products add reminders and records. This shifted the design focus to the complete routine before and after taking medication.
en.把访谈与观察，转化为清晰的需求: Turning interviews and observation into priorities
en.访谈围绕日常服药习惯、遗忘和中断、产品使用偏好及家属参与展开。行为观察将过程拆为: Interviews explored daily routines, forgetting and interruptions, product preferences and family involvement. Observation separated retrieving, sorting, preparing water and taking medication. Counting tablets, holding several medicines and moving back and forth for water all add effort. Priorities became reminders, storage and portion dispensing, with remote family assistance.
en.用教具模拟，发现操作中的负担: Using ageing-simulation equipment to reveal difficulty
en.模拟任务包括上下楼、更换饮用水、分药、接热水、倒药与语音沟通。PPT 的单次体验: Tasks included stairs, replacing drinking water, sorting tablets, collecting hot water, pouring tablets and voice communication. In one documented simulation, sorting took 4 min 9 sec and collecting hot water took 1 min 24 sec. Similar colours, wrist strain and water-level visibility informed colour, height, materials and feedback design.
en.把提醒、取药与饮水连在一起: Connecting reminders, retrieval and drinking water
en.故事板将预设提醒、准备温水、听到提示、取杯、选择对应药品、取药、饮水和完成反馈串: The storyboard links scheduled reminders, warm-water preparation, hearing the alert, taking a cup, selecting medication, retrieval, drinking and completion feedback. Storage, dispensing and family assistance form the concept. Importing prescriptions from an electronic pharmacy was recorded as a possible future function.
en.把储药与饮水放进同一件日常产品: Bringing storage and water into one everyday object
en.造型围绕储药区域、取水区与杯座组织，采用暖白与橙色建立温暖、易识别的视觉关系。体: The form arranges medication storage, the water outlet and the cup base. Warm white and orange establish a gentle, legible appearance. Volume studies include a roughly 2 L reservoir and a 400 mL cup. Packaging, tablet dimensions and storage requirements inform the structural studies.
en.设备端，让操作与完成状态清楚可见: The device: making actions and status visible
en.饮水主页面集中显示水温、温度调节、水量选择和接水入口，顶部保留清洁与锁定功能。服: The water screen groups temperature, adjustment, volume selection and dispensing, with cleaning and locking controls above. The medication screen uses reminders, selection, illuminated icons and completion text to distinguish pending actions from completed ones.
en.手机端，让家属参与查看和设置: The app: helping family members view and configure
en.首页通过日期、服药时间和药品种类概览组织信息，再展示具体药品与剂量。方案设计了完: Dates, medication times and a category overview lead into specific medicines and dosage information. The concept includes completion status, adding medication information and configuring reminders and quantities, keeping device and app focused on the same routine.
en.让概念进入真实的家居尺度: Testing the concept in a domestic setting
en.通过不同光线和摆放方式的产品渲染，检查储药区、取水区域与杯座的视觉关系，并呈现产: Product renderings explore placement and lighting, examining the relationship between the storage area, water outlet and cup base, and showing how the concept could sit within a home.

Outside work, I enjoy languages, fitness, animation, video editing and games.
